cases.observed: Handbag seller demo testimonial claims love for 'Leo Bikini Bottoms', an unrelated apparel/bikini SKU; Jane Doe example name elsewhere.
cases.risk: Reused sample reviews undermine trust and should not imply verified customer or connected product feedback.
cases.vsn_guard: Hide empty, sample or unapproved reviews; require merchant-controlled product/category relevance, consent and evidence; never fabricate endorsements.

cases.observed: Amanda Bag Pink is labeled Pre-order alongside several color-specific separate product cards.
cases.risk: Source markup alone cannot prove real preorder checkout, variant cross-link or expected fulfillment date.
cases.vsn_guard: Connect genuine pre-order SKU/availability, merchant release window/lead time and tested Add-to-Cart checkout route; distinguish separate linked SKUs from variant option values.

cases.observed: Homepage claims eco-friendly luxury, Lifetime Warranty and exclusive designs.
cases.risk: Warranty term, environmental/brand origin and certification not substantiated by demo HTML; shouldn't ship in reusable theme defaults.
cases.vsn_guard: Render only merchant-verified policy pages and scoped product/category trust badges; provide blank states.

cases.observed: Supplementary FAQ says orders can be returned within 30 days and refunds processed within 14 business days after receipt.
cases.risk: Indexed FAQ copy isn't authenticated live returns configuration, legal obligation or market eligibility.
cases.vsn_guard: Keep returns policies centrally configured by market and version, expose accurate links next to cart/PDP and do not hardcode timing defaults.
